notes.5-1283:
Binary search on the divisor from `1` to `max(nums)`.

For every guessed divisor `mid`, calculate:

```cpp
sum += (num + mid - 1) / mid;
```

This is the integer version of:

```cpp
ceil((double)num / mid)
```

Then compare the calculated `sum` with `threshold`.

* If `sum <= threshold`, the divisor works. Set `r = mid`, not `mid - 1`, because we need the smallest valid divisor and `mid` itself may be the answer.
* If `sum > threshold`, the divisor is too small. Smaller divisors will produce an even larger sum, so discard the left half using `l = mid + 1`.

When `l == r`, both pointers are at the smallest valid divisor, so return `l`.

notes.9-739: Use a monotonic decreasing stack of indices. Each index in the stack represents a previous day still waiting for a warmer temperature. While the current temperature is greater than the temperature at the stack’s top index, pop that index and set its answer as currentIndex - previousIndex. Then push the current index. Any indices left in the stack at the end have no warmer future day, so their answer remains 0. Time complexity is O(n) because every index is pushed and popped at most once.
